items.title: Allan Vaché interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 15, 2000
items.q: it was like one of these all-star bands — it was Bob Haggart and Butch and Johnny Varro and Bob Havens and myself, Ed Polcer.

ctx.x: Well no, it was like one of these all-star bands — it was Bob Haggart and Butch and Johnny Varro and Bob Havens and myself, Ed Polcer. I can’t remember all the guys on the band. But it was about an eight or nine piece band.
Any reaction to the music over there?
